warnings: Each truss uses two printed sections: rectangular tube 100x50x1.7 (chords / end posts) and 75x38x1.7 (the other members, per the leader lines). The first goes in steel_section; the second is recorded as web_steel_section (new key — section 6a allows only one steel_section object per member; reuse this name for a second truss section).
The printed symbol before both sizes is a slashed rectangle, read as a rectangular hollow section (RHS); the print is kept in printed_as.
T1's 0.893 depth is printed at its high (row C) end; the truss slopes down towards row A where it sits on the อะเส. T3 prints 0.790 and T2 0.421 — kept as printed, not reconciled against T1.
The 1.000 x 6 panel chains under all three trusses are recorded in the grid master (dimension_chains); their ticks became x/y dummy lines per section 4 rule 4.
